mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (current level) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales signals a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, triggering reduced corporate revenue expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative monetary policy to support labor markets, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production level indicates robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO is above its 12-month rolling average.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1700.0 thousand units signals weak residential construction activity, reducing sector investment and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when HOUST < 1700.0.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year inflation rate above 3.0% (as measured by CPIAUCSL) signals an inflationary environment that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL yoy > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising non-farm payroll count indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS is above its 12-month rolling average.
